title: Move signup email to a background job (example)
prompt: In this Next.js app, sending the welcome email blocks the signup request. Move it to a background job with retries.

title: Persist todos in a real database (example)
prompt: The todos in this app are kept in memory and disappear on restart. Store them in a proper database and add a migration.

title: Add authentication to a FastAPI service (example)
prompt: Add user sign-up and login to this FastAPI service. Users should be able to sign in with Google too.

title: Nightly activity digest (example)
prompt: Add a nightly job to this Next.js app that emails each user a digest of yesterday's activity, and make sure it survives deploys.

title: Resize uploaded images off the request path (example)
prompt: Uploads in this Express API resize images inline and time out on large files. Do the resizing after the upload returns, with retries, and show progress.

title: Large CSV exports without timeouts (example)
prompt: Exporting a year of orders as CSV from this FastAPI service times out. Generate the file in the background and email a download link when it is ready.

title: One-off file rename script (example)
prompt: Write a one-off Node script that renames the files in ./images to lowercase. It runs once on my laptop.
